;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Dissident Irish Republican campaign]]
**Two people were shot and injured in two individual attacks in [[Londonderry]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-foyle-west-47101445 (BBC)]
**[[Ammunition]] and a [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar tube]] was found at the [[Republic of Ireland–United Kingdom border|Irish border]] in [[County Louth]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47094645 (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[Associated Press]] and [[Snopes]] say they are no longer providing [[fact-checking]] services for  [[Facebook]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-47098021 (BBC News)]
*[[Boy Scouts of America membership controversies]], [[Boy Scouts of America]], [[Gender equality]] 
**The Boy Scouts officially changes its name to [[Scouts BSA]] and young women join as official members of the organization for the first time. [https://abc6onyourside.com/news/local/scout-me-in-girls-can-now-join-scouts-bsa (ABC6)] [https://www.scoutingnewsroom.org/press-releases/thousands-girls-boys-families-celebrate-historic-launch-scouts-bsa/ (Scouting Newsroom)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[January 2019 North American cold wave]]
**The death toll from a [[North America|North American]] [[cold wave]] caused by a [[polar vortex]] rises to at least 21 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47088684 (BBC News)]
**A large-scale [[natural gas]] shortage in the U.S. state of [[Michigan]] is averted following the compliance of an emergency request from [[Consumers Energy]] for state residents to lower [[thermostat|thermostats]], after a fire at a natural gas compressor station threatened to halt the delivery of gas to consumers. The public's observance of the request resulted in a 10 percent decrease in natural gas usage across the state. [https://www.wnem.com/news/consumers-energy-s-plea-to-lower-thermostats-averts-gas-crisis/article_1c9395cc-25a6-11e9-9fd9-c719a4280c2b.html?fbclid=IwAR2F2REZcXrbH2Kw9WSLJbj3l0SB0HOsWGCsXjwJAlgNBotbX0KiPtE8UvI (WNEM-TV)] [https://www.apnews.com/ebd5a4d1cae6414fb3c8bed71e61bb41 (Associated Press)]

*Three students at a school in [[Johannesburg]], [[South Africa]], are killed after a footbridge connecting the main school administration to various class rooms collapses. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/walkway-collapse-at-south-african-school-kills-3/1380884 (AA)]

;International relations
*[[Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty]], [[Cold War II]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[Secretary of state of the United States|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] announces that the [[United States]] is suspending its role in the [[Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty]], an agreement made in 1987 with the [[USSR]] (and, by extension, its successor state [[Russia]]) banning both countries from possessing or testing nuclear and conventional [[intermediate-range ballistic missile|intermediate-range missiles]], as well as their launchers, citing Russian non-compliance with the treaty. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/01/politics/us-russia-nuclear-arms-treaty-pompeo/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**U.S. [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[New Jersey]] [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Cory Booker]] announces that he is running for the office of the presidency in the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 presidential election]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/01/politics/cory-booker-announces-presidential-run-2020/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] and [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] leaders call for the resignation of [[Governor of Virginia|Governor]] [[Ralph Northam]] after a 1984 [[yearbook]] photograph apparently featuring Northam surfaces showing one person wearing [[blackface]] and another person wearing [[Ku Klux Klan]] attire. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/428146-top-dem-super-pac-chief-activist-group-call-on-northam-to-resign?fbclid=IwAR1vnwJsTd9-zNjzXv-eFDCecFxfpLid_TZ4Lo9QUXVfb1FUByRK6Q_Agys (''The Hill'')]

;Science and technology
*A [[meteorite]] strikes near the [[Cuba]]n town of [[Viñales]], in the western province of [[Pinar del Río Province|Pinar del Río]],  after sightings of a fireball over the [[Florida Keys]]. The last confirmed meteorite to hit Cuba was in 1994. [https://www.dw.com/en/cuba-reports-meteorite-strike-with-fragments-falling-on-pinar-del-rio/a-47332892 (DW)]

;Sports
*[[2019 AFC Asian Cup]]
**[[Qatar national football team|Qatar]] [[2019 AFC Asian Cup Final|defeats]] [[Japan national football team|Japan]] 3-1 to win the [[2019 AFC Asian Cup]], earning them their first continental championship title. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2019/feb/01/qatar-stun-japan-with-3-1-win-to-be-crowned-asian-cup-champions (''The Guardian'')]
*American Olympic [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]] [[Lindsey Vonn]] announces she will retire after the [[2018–19 FIS Alpine Ski World Cup|53rd Alpine Ski World Cup]] in [[Sweden]], which is currently taking place and will conclude in March. [http://time.com/5518558/lindsey-vonn-announces-retirement/ (''Time'')]
